get.summary: List the organization's API keys (secrets are never returned).

post.summary: Mint an organization API key for automation (e.g. Terraform). The plaintext token is returned once.

delete.summary: Revoke an organization API key. Idempotent from the caller's view.

post.summary: Accept an organization invite: set a password (if new) and sign in to the org.
Exchange credentials for an access + refresh token. Returns membership list when no organization_id is given and multiple memberships exist.
Revoke the supplied refresh token's session. Idempotent.

get.summary: Return the authenticated account, its verified-or-pending emails, and its org memberships.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token, returning a new access + refresh pair.
Create an account, organization, and first user; enqueue tenant provisioning.
Issue a new token pair scoped to another organization the account belongs to.
Consume a verification token to mark an email address verified. Idempotent.

get.summary: List datacenters in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a datacenter in the caller's tenant.
Discover hypervisors from the datacenter's Proxmox cluster and upsert them (preserving reserved capacity and schedulable). Set async to run in the background.

get.summary: List hypervisors in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a hypervisor in the caller's tenant.

get.summary: List the organizations the caller belongs to (with their role).

post.summary: Create an organization (you become its owner) and enqueue tenant provisioning.

delete.summary: Delete an organization and enqueue tenant teardown (owner only).

get.summary: Get an organization the caller belongs to.

post.summary: Add or invite a member by email (admin+; owner required to grant owner). Unknown emails get an invite link.

delete.summary: Remove a member (admin+; owner required to remove owners; never the last owner).

patch.summary: Change a member's role (admin+; owner required to touch owners).

get.summary: List all placements in the tenant with pool, slot, and hypervisor context (fleet overview).

delete.summary: Remove a placement. The pool's desired_count is not adjusted; resize the pool to re-fill the vacancy.

get.summary: Fetch a single placement with its pool, hypervisor, and vmid.

patch.summary: Attach the externally-assigned Proxmox vmid to a placement.

get.summary: List node pools in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a node pool and place its VMs across hypervisors (anti-affinity spread, all-or-nothing). Placements are available at GET /pools/{id}/placements.

delete.summary: Delete a pool and release all its placements.

get.summary: Fetch a pool. Its placements are available at GET /pools/{id}/placements.

patch.summary: Resize a pool's desired count. Grow places new VMs (all-or-nothing); shrink removes newest placements (LIFO). Placements are available at GET /pools/{id}/placements.

get.summary: List a pool's placements (hypervisor + optional vmid).

parameters.description: Filter to the slot with this exact (unique) name.
parameters.name: name

schema.description: Filter to the slot with this exact (unique) name.

get.summary: List slots in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a slot (t-shirt-size VM template) in the caller's tenant.
